description.value: SASCU Recreation Centre is a large community facility in Salmon Arm operated by the non-profit Shuswap Recreation Society, featuring a pool, hot tub, fitness room, racquet courts, indoor walking track, and the twin-sheet NHL-regulation Rogers Rink arena. The complex also includes an auditorium, meeting rooms, and nearby sports fields, serving as a major recreational hub for residents and visiting athletes alike. Touring cyclists passing through Salmon Arm may find it a practical stop for aquatic and fitness amenities.
